notes.title: Early Access v21
notes.notes: [p]Hello again, everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We know the long absence of any updates scares a lot of people. However, we'd like to assure you that we are going nowhere! Game development is not only our job, but our passion in life! We will always be transparent and communicative with our communities! We love an appreciate our community! <3 We'd also like to apologize for the long delay for this update. This update took [i]many[/i] months because it was [i]extremely[/i] time-consuming. Nevertheless, we're happy to announce we're finally done with the entire UI upgrade and can now continue developing content for the game![/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the [i]entire[/i] game's UI. (I can almost guarantee you that we missed a few UI windows - if you find any, please let us know in our Discord so we can fix them asap)[/p][/*][/list]
